Copy footer and page settings from the last section to every section

Source: R/docx_sync_sections.R
docx_sync_sections.Rd

docx_sync_sections() copies the header and footer references, page margins, and page size from the last section of a Word document to the other sections, filling in what each section is missing.

This fixes documents rendered by Quarto or Pandoc where section breaks don't carry the reference document's page settings, for example when using Quarto's .landscape divs (which add section breaks with no footer, no margins, and an A4 landscape page size) or a custom OpenXML template. See the "Page settings and sections" section of brand_reference_docx().

For each section other than the last:

  • If the section has no header or footer references, the last section's references are added.

  • If the section has no page margins, the last section's margins are added.

  • If the section has no page size, the last section's page size is added. If page_size = TRUE, landscape sections also get the last section's page size with the width and height swapped (and portrait sections get the last section's page size).

To use docx_sync_sections() in a Quarto project, add a post-render script to _quarto.yml:

project:
  post-render: post-render.R

With a post-render.R file:

output_files <- strsplit(Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_OUTPUT_FILES"), "\n")[[1]]

for (file in output_files[grepl("\\.docx$", output_files)]) {
  officerExtras::docx_sync_sections(file)
}

Usage

docx_sync_sections(x, path = NULL, page_size = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A rdocx object or a path to a docx file.

path

Output file path. If NULL (default) and x is a file path, x is overwritten. If NULL and x is a rdocx object, the document is not written to a file.

page_size

If TRUE (default), set the page size of every section to the last section's page size (with the width and height swapped for landscape sections). If FALSE, only add a page size to sections without one.

Value

A rdocx object (invisibly if a file is written).

Examples

docx <- officer::read_docx()
docx <- officer::body_add_par(docx, "Portrait")
docx <- officer::body_end_section_portrait(docx)
docx <- officer::body_add_par(docx, "Landscape")
docx <- officer::body_end_section_landscape(docx)

docx_sync_sections(docx)
